description: What the opening view's answer does with the camera (apps/android/docs/SPEC.md FR-2.3), decided when it lands: moves it onto the newest tracks found, holds the move for an open Trip, whose own flight frames it, or leaves it: nothing found, a live recording's camera, a flight already asked for, or a camera moved since the read went out, by the user or the app. A held move is taken when the Trip closes only if nothing has moved the camera since, the Trip's own flight included: a Trip with nothing to fly to leaves the map where the opening view would have put it.

cases.name: tracks found, nothing else going on
nothing found with a Trip open
the camera moved since the read went out
a Trip is open and the camera moved
a Trip is open while recording
